name: @a9n9/comms
description: Per-agent messaging connector: one agent's own SMS number (Plivo) and WhatsApp number (Meta Cloud API). Inbound goes to that agent's inbox; outbound is reply-first with consent, the WhatsApp 24-hour window and daily caps enforced in code. Plus wa-relay: the stateless fan-out Meta's one-webhook-per-app design requires.
